Gifted: Copy.description:
🧬 Copy, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start bare skin contact lends you a person's Emitter or Transformation Quirk for a few minutes at a beginner's level, enough to turn it on its owner's attacks.
📈 With training: riding copied movement, tracking a Quirk to its owner, rescues beside the heroes you copy, several copies, a copy at full power, every copy fired in turn.
⚠️ You hold one copy at a time, without its owner's practice or stored power; Mutant features and Quirkless people give you nothing.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Time Limit, as copies run out early.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Neito Monoma (Copy).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Copy.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Copy family): Scale: skin-to-skin touch copies a person's Quirk. New adult user: one copy at a time, about five minutes, at beginner level (basic effect, without the owner's practice or stored power); a new copy replaces the old; the owner keeps theirs. More needs techniques. Limits: no Mutant features or anything needing a body part the user lacks; Quirkless people give nothing; gloves and armor block the touch; copies lack the matching body (copied fire can burn the user's hands). Quirk Strain: light: taking a copy, answering its owner, plus the copy's usual cost; moderate: riding a copied movement, tracing an owner, shared rescue; heavy: several copies, opening one fully; severe: signature sequence, splicing two copies. Type: Emitter. Law: copying without consent is unlawful Quirk use; a copy used in a crime points police at its registered owner until they check for copiers.
